translationRepairs: In Tianchen year 3 he followed the Last Ruler home to court and was made Marquis of Kangle with a fief of five hundred households.
In Tianjia year 3 he followed the Last Ruler home to court and was made Marquis of Kangle with a fief of five hundred households.
天嘉三年 is Chen Wen's Tianjia year 3; Tianchen misreads 嘉 as 陳. Tianjia restores the correct reign name.
In the third year of Tianchen, he followed the Last Ruler back to court, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Kangle with a fief of five hundred households.
In the third year of Tianjia, he followed the Last Ruler back to court, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Kangle with a fief of five hundred households.
Same unit: 天嘉 is Tianjia, not Tianchen. The literal replacement matches the reign name in the Chinese.
In Tianchen year 6 he was made Prince of Xin'an with a fief of two thousand households.
In Tianjia year 6 he was made Prince of Xin'an with a fief of two thousand households.
天嘉六年 is Tianjia year 6; Tianchen is the same reign misreading as in s0009. Tianjia is correct.
In the sixth year of Tianchen, he was established as Prince of Xin'an with a fief of two thousand households.
In the sixth year of Tianjia, he was established as Prince of Xin'an with a fief of two thousand households.
Same unit: 天嘉 is Tianjia, not Tianchen. The literal replacement matches the Chinese reign name.
Seeing the cause was lost, he meant to flee; the four gates were already shut and he could not leave, so together they made for Baimang Road.
Seeing the cause was lost, he meant to flee; the four gates were already shut and he could not leave, so together they made for Baiyang Road.
白楊道 is Baiyang Road (白楊), not Baimang. The proposed spelling restores the toponym.
Knowing affairs would not succeed, he wished to flee; it happened that the four gates were already shut and he could not get out, so together they made for Baimang Road.
Knowing affairs would not succeed, he wished to flee; it happened that the four gates were already shut and he could not get out, so together they made for Baiyang Road.
Same unit: 白楊道 is Baiyang Road. The literal replacement corrects the misread place name.
Rong arrived; mutinous troops killed him; his body lay at the gate of the Dongchang hostel; he was twenty-eight.
When the court cavalry arrived, he was killed by mutinous troops; his body lay at the gate of the Dongchang hostel; he was twenty-eight.

Preceding 臺馬 with collation （客） and 容至 mark the court cavalry's arrival, not a person Rong. Age 二十八 and the following edict on 伯固 identify Bogu as the dead man; the replacement removes the invented name.
